title: The Risk Lives Between the Boxes
altText: Official NIST AI RMF GOVERN 2 excerpt requiring clear roles and communication lines, trained personnel and partners, and executive responsibility for AI-risk decisions.
caption: NIST AI RMF GOVERN 2 assigns clear communication lines, partner duties and executive responsibility across organizational handoffs.
credit: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, p. 23. Republished courtesy of NIST.
claimBoundary: Supports documenting responsibility and communication across teams and partners; it does not prove Build 017 resolves organizational handoff risk.
noEndorsement: Use only the exact document treatment under its recorded terms. Exclude logos, seals, people and third-party material; attribution does not imply that National Institute of Standards and Technology endorses RN or Build 017.
rightsLine: NIST-authored technical-series text; citation retained; insignia and third-party material excluded.
